build_unet_sparse_model: build a sparse convolutional UNet model using scn.UNet with configurable depth and residual blocks
create_sparse_sequential_pipeline: create a sparse convolutional pipeline with scn.Sequential, InputLayer, SubmanifoldConvolution, and OutputLayer
train_sparse_unet_model: train a sparse UNet model on ScanNet data using Adam optimizer and cross-entropy loss
checkpoint_restore_save_model: checkpoint restore and save a sparse convolutional model using scn.checkpoint_restore and scn.checkpoint_save
evaluate_model_iou_metric: evaluate a sparse UNet model on validation data using iou.evaluate for mean intersection-over-union scoring
